title: Add agentic TUI acceptance harness
description: Build a test harness for lazycurl's TUI so agents can drive user flows, capture rendered UI state, and write acceptance tests that guard regressions in core UI use cases.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can drive representative UI actions; tests can assert rendered UI text/state; at least one acceptance test covers a real lazycurl flow; build exposes a runnable test step; docs explain how to add scenarios.
notes: Implemented in-process Vaxis screen harness plus acceptance scenarios. Verified scenarios with direct Zig 0.15.1 test command using macOS 15 sysroot and ASCII uucode stub; ./dev.sh acceptance is blocked locally by Zig 0.15.1 build-runner link failure on macOS 26 SDK (__availability_version_check, _abort, _bzero, etc.).
close_reason: Completed: TUI harness merged; Zig 0.16/vaxis main migration unblocked ./dev.sh acceptance; fmt/test/acceptance/build pass.
